terrain.processing: Bounded nearest-sample relief, hillshade and raster 100 m contour crossings. Batan/Itbayat land/sea masking from complete OSM coastline rings. Flat sea is not bathymetry. One-arc-second (~30 m) output grid; merged source resolution varies and can be coarser. Not survey accuracy.
